variants.prompt: On the deck of a luxury yacht, a couple in skimpy, white beach attire recline on a plush, striped blanket. The woman, her long, raven hair cascading down her back, holds a probe in each hand, her pouty lips curled into a seductive smile as she gazes at her partner. The man, his chiseled features and tanned skin glistening in the fading light of sunset, reaches out to caress her thigh, his eyes dark with desire. The warm, golden tones of the late afternoon sky mingle with the soft, blue hues of the ocean, creating a breathtaking, idyllic scene of love and temptation.
